newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end down, led by financials, builders.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end down, led by financials, builders.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended lower on Monday, as afternoon selling in the financial and construction sectors erased early gains by exporters, whose shares were buoyed by the yen's weakening against the dollar, brokers said.
The Nikkei average fell 144.92 points or 0.81 percent to 17,715.67. June Nikkei futures lost 200 points to 17,650.

Although there were no new developments fuelling the drop in financial shares, the dissolution of cross-shareholdings continued to weigh on the sector and dealers after fast profits jumped onto the bandwagon, said Harushige Kobayashi, Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd deputy general manager.
